position.imagery_frame_basis: inferred from registration to 1 lidar survey(s): mean residual WGS84-service 0.61 m, NAD83(2011) 1.24 m

reference.name: ct-2023
reference.basis: tested: RMSEx 0.072 m, RMSEy 0.060 m on 179 independent checkpoints (CT_ortho_2023_metadata.xml); CE95 = 2.4477 x RMS per axis

checks.reference_basis: designed to 1.0 m RMSEx/y (ASPRS 2014); design class, not tested

selection.rule: min(absolute CE95 + 4 m x unseen share)

racing_line.method: minimum curvature inside the measured edges (car half width kept off each edge), quasi-steady-state lap: grip with downforce, power, braking, friction ellipse
racing_line.limitations: model, not a measurement: no elevation, no kerbs, a generic car

imagery.name: Connecticut 2023 statewide orthoimagery (CT ECO, UConn CLEAR / CT DEEP)
imagery.license: no restrictions; acknowledgement appreciated (CT ECO metadata)
imagery.horizontal_accuracy: tested: RMSEx 0.072 m, RMSEy 0.060 m on 179 independent checkpoints (CT_ortho_2023_metadata.xml); CE95 = 2.4477 x RMS per axis

reference.name: CT_Statewide_B7_2016
reference.horizontal_accuracy: designed to 1.0 m RMSEx/y (ASPRS 2014); design class, not tested

seed.name: layout centerline (OpenStreetMap)
seed.use: seed only: fixes lap order, origin and direction; the edges are measured
